blindness.line: You pray for rain, I pray for blindness
stanza: They say it fades if you let it
Love was made to forget it
I carved your name across my eyelids
You pray for rain, I pray for blindness

kindness.line: Just playin', I kill 'em with kindness
kindness.linePrev: 'Cause I'll go straight for your esophagus
kindness.lineNext: I'm full of life like metropolis, you know I rock this shit

stanza: Twas on a night like this
I blew in through your door
And you gave me that and more
You tought me how to do
